newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Everbright Bank gets $60 mln loans, $20 mln equity.
newsitem.headline: Everbright Bank gets $60 mln loans, $20 mln equity.

text.p: The Asian Development Bank (ADB) said on Tuesday it had agreed to grant a $60 million loan and infuse $20 million in equity into Everbright Bank of China (EBBC).
Everbright is one of the six commercial banks in China with a nationwide presence.
The loan, which would be channelled through the Chinese government, is repayable in 15 years, including a grace period of four years.
Interest rates will be based on ADB's market-based lending rate for U.S. dollar loans.
EBBC is expectd to relend the money to about 10 to 15 agro-processing and industrial projects in the country, the bank said.
The $20 million equity was sourced from its private sector window.

"The Bank's direct equity investment in EBBC represents a first foreign investment in a local state-owned commercial bank, further improving the investment environment of the financial sector," the bank said in a statement.
A separate technical assistance was also given to EBBC for it "to formulate and initiate a major long-term capacity-building programme to ensure its transformation into a model commercial bank."
